content: Expo Go testing realities (docs + widely-documented behavior): Expo Go bundles a fixed set of native modules — anything else requires a dev build; the Expo Go app supports ONE SDK version at a time. Dev-mode JS bundle is served by Metro over LAN — airplane mode kills Metro connectivity: the app cannot (re)load its bundle offline (cold start offline shows no app), so offline-first behavior is only testable AFTER the app is already running; code updates require reconnection. Reload (Fast Refresh / r) re-executes JS but AsyncStorage + Firestore cache persist — good for testing persistence. JS is suspended in background — timers and network stop; Firestore sync resumes on foreground (queue flushes, listeners re-fire). Known gotchas: 'r' reload can duplicate module-level Firebase init (guard with a singleton / module cache); QR code requires same-LAN multicast (use --tunnel when LAN isolation blocks it); Android 10+ write-to-Downloads requires SAF permission flow (Expo Go has no manifest — SAF picker is the way).
